_comment: Committed baseline from `npm run ai-bench`, captured before the D4 performance pass (Phase 12 planning). This is the only valid pre-optimization measurement — see BACKLOG.md D4. Not asserted against directly by a test (the archetype loop is stochastic across 12 seeded matches per row and legitimately shifts a few units run to run); it exists for a human to diff `npm run ai-bench` output against after each optimization step. The cross-process decision golden in tests/golden.test.ts is the automated guard.
